dedupe_keys.name: annotated mobile laser scans of the dutch railway environment

description: Annotated mobile laser scans of the Dutch railway environment is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Bram Ton, Strukton Rail. This dataset contains point cloud data of two stretches of railway track in the Netherlands. One stretch covers the trajectory between Deventer and Twello, the other stretch is located around Dronten. The data have been captured using a Veldodyne VLP-16 mobile laser scanner mounted on a dedicated measurement train by Strukton Rail. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: Point cloud. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
